tasks.prompt:
CONTEXT: BeLikeNative (belikenative.com) is a Chrome extension for AI writing help. We're building backlinks via cross-publishing articles to high-DA platforms with canonical URLs pointing back to belikenative.com. Currently live: Dev.to (DA 62, canonical_url field) and Telegraph/telegra.ph (DA 90, embedded backlinks). 2,199 WordPress articles available. Hashnode API died (301), Medium blocked new tokens since Jan 2025.

TASK: Research ALL publishing platforms with free APIs that support creating articles/posts programmatically in 2026. For each platform: (1) Domain Authority score, (2) whether canonical_url is supported, (3) API complexity (trivial/moderate/hard), (4) signup requirements, (5) rate limits, (6) content restrictions, (7) link attributes (dofollow vs nofollow). Include lesser-known platforms. Rank by backlink value = DA x canonical_support x ease_of_automation.
tasks.system_prompt: You are an SEO and API integration specialist. Focus on platforms with working APIs in 2026. Verify API endpoints are current. Provide specific URLs for API documentation.

tasks.prompt:
CONTEXT: Building automated backlink pipeline for belikenative.com. Need platforms with APIs.

TASK: Deep dive into Google Blogger/Blogspot API for automated publishing. (1) Current API endpoints and authentication (OAuth 2.0 flow), (2) Can you set canonical URLs in the HTML template? (3) What's the exact API call to create a post? (4) Rate limits, (5) Can you create multiple blogs under one account? (6) Is the link dofollow? (7) What's blogspot.com's current DA? (8) Step-by-step setup guide for automated publishing. (9) Any anti-spam detection? (10) Template customization for SEO meta tags.
tasks.system_prompt: You are a Google API integration expert. Provide exact API endpoints, authentication flows, and code examples.

tasks.prompt:
CONTEXT: Building automated backlink pipeline. Need to understand GitHub Pages for SEO backlinks.

TASK: Analyze GitHub Pages (github.io) as a backlink platform. (1) Current DA of github.io, (2) Can you set canonical URLs via HTML meta tags? (3) Automated publishing via GitHub API (create/update files), (4) Jekyll vs static HTML — which is better for SEO? (5) Can you have multiple repos = multiple github.io sites? (6) Are links dofollow? (7) How does Google treat github.io pages for indexing? (8) Rate limits for GitHub API, (9) Best practices for maximizing SEO value from GitHub Pages. (10) Can you use custom domains with GitHub Pages for even more backlink diversity?
tasks.system_prompt: You are a technical SEO expert specializing in developer platforms. Provide specific technical details and API endpoints.

tasks.prompt:
CONTEXT: Cross-publishing articles from belikenative.com to build backlinks.

TASK: Research WordPress.com free tier API for automated publishing. (1) Can free-tier blogs set canonical URLs? (2) REST API endpoints for creating posts, (3) Authentication (OAuth, application passwords), (4) DA of wordpress.com subdomains, (5) Are links dofollow? (6) Content restrictions on free tier, (7) Rate limits, (8) Can you create multiple free blogs? (9) Does WordPress.com penalize duplicate content? (10) Jetpack vs REST API differences. Also research WordPress.org self-hosted as comparison — what's the cheapest hosting for a WP install just for backlinks?
tasks.system_prompt: You are a WordPress ecosystem expert. Distinguish clearly between WordPress.com and WordPress.org. Provide current 2026 API details.

tasks.prompt:

tasks.prompt:

tasks.prompt:
CONTEXT: Building backlinks for belikenative.com, an AI writing Chrome extension.

tasks.prompt:
CONTEXT: Cross-publishing 2,199 articles with canonical URLs to belikenative.com.

TASK: Analyze the SEO impact and risks of large-scale cross-publishing. (1) Does Google penalize cross-posting the same content to 5-10 platforms? (2) How does canonical_url affect duplicate content penalties? (3) What's the optimal publication velocity (articles per day per platform) to avoid spam detection? (4) Do search engines devalue backlinks from mass cross-publishing? (5) What's the difference between syndication and spam in Google's eyes? (6) Case studies of sites that successfully used cross-publishing for SEO, (7) Warning signs that you're over-doing it, (8) How to vary content per platform to maximize value.
tasks.system_prompt: You are a technical SEO strategist. Provide evidence-based answers about Google's syndication policies. Reference Google documentation and real case studies.

tasks.prompt:
CONTEXT: BeLikeNative backlink pipeline currently has: Dev.to (DA 62, canonical, REST API, LIVE) and Telegraph (DA 90, embedded links, LIVE). 12 backlinks created so far. 2,199 articles in queue. TASK: Design the optimal multi-platform backlink strategy for belikenative.com. tasks.prompt:
CONTEXT: Using Claude Code + DeepSeek for automated content adaptation. Dev.to articles cost ~$0.03 per Claude rewrite. Telegraph reuses Dev.to content for $0.

TASK: Design cost-optimized content adaptation strategies for maximum platform coverage. (1) Which platforms can share the same adapted content? (2) How to minimize Claude API calls — can one rewrite serve 3-4 platforms? (3) DeepSeek vs Claude for content rewriting — quality comparison for SEO content, (4) Can DeepSeek handle the humanization rules (banned words, sentence rhythm, no bold)? (5) Cost modeling: what's the total cost to create 1000 backlinks across 5 platforms? (6) Template-based adaptation vs full AI rewrite — when is each appropriate?
tasks.system_prompt: You are an AI pipeline optimization expert. Focus on minimizing cost while maintaining content quality.

tasks.prompt:

tasks.prompt:
CONTEXT: Running a backlink pipeline that publishes articles to multiple platforms with canonical URLs.

TASK: Research the exact mechanics of how canonical URLs transfer SEO value. (1) How much link juice does a canonical tag actually pass? (Is it 100% like 301? Less?) (2) Does Google always respect canonical_url on third-party sites? (3) Dev.to canonical_url — has Google confirmed it respects this? Evidence? (4) Embedded backlinks (like Telegraph) vs canonical tags — SEO value comparison, (5) How long does it take for a new backlink to affect rankings? (6) Does anchor text in embedded backlinks matter? (7) How to measure backlink impact with Google Search Console, (8) Are there diminishing returns from same-domain backlinks (e.g., 100 links from dev.to)?
tasks.system_prompt: You are a technical SEO researcher. Cite Google documentation, patents, and industry studies. Distinguish between confirmed facts and SEO folklore.

tasks.prompt:
CONTEXT: BeLikeNative WordPress site with 2,199 articles. Building backlink pipeline.

TASK: What are the most effective internal linking and on-page SEO improvements that amplify the value of incoming backlinks? (1) Internal linking structure to distribute link juice, (2) Topical cluster/pillar page strategy, (3) Which pages should receive the most backlinks? (4) How to prioritize articles for cross-publishing (by traffic potential, keyword difficulty, current ranking), (5) Should every article get backlinks or focus on 50-100 key pages? (6) Hub-and-spoke vs flat internal linking, (7) How to identify pages that would benefit most from one additional backlink.
tasks.system_prompt: You are an on-page SEO strategist. Focus on maximizing the ROI of incoming backlinks through site architecture.

tasks.prompt:

(6) How to add unique value to each platform version to avoid thin content penalties, (7) Schema markup opportunities on publishing platforms.

tasks.prompt:

tasks.prompt:
